[[File:Mimic scroll case detail.png|150px|left]]
The '''Mimic scroll case''' is a type of [[scroll case]] awarded from defeating [[the Mimic]] boss (elite or master casket mimic) and then opening the [[Reward casket (elite)|elite]]/[[Reward casket (master)|master reward casket]] it came from, which raises the cap on the number of scroll boxes for all tiers by 1. Opening the case results in the message {{mes|You have increased the capacity for all of your clue scrolls by one!}} in the chatbox.

If the player has defeated the Mimic boss ''before'' the update that added scroll cases on [[2 July]] [[2025]], this scroll case will be automatically added to the [[collection log]] and its benefits will already be applied to their scroll box capacity.
